requirement_text: The system must be available as a mobile application on Android and iOS devices.
requirement_reference: "We are currently developing a mobile football app that will be available for Android and iOS devices."

user_story.story: As a mobile football fan, I want to use the app on Android or iOS so that I can access its features on my device.
user_story.Acceptance: Given I use a supported Android or iOS device, When I install and launch the app, Then the application must be available and operable on that platform.

requirement_text: The system must display current football news for users' favorite teams.
requirement_reference: "To achieve this, users can display current football news of their favorite teams"

user_story.story: As a football fan, I want to see current news about my favorite teams so that I can stay informed.
user_story.Acceptance: Given I have selected one or more favorite teams, When I open the news section, Then the system must display current football news related to those teams.

requirement_text: The system must allow users to select preferred sports channels individually for news content.
requirement_reference: "and also select preferred sports channels individually."

user_story.story: As a football fan, I want to choose my preferred sports channels so that I can personalize my news sources.
user_story.Acceptance: Given I am in the personalization or settings area, When I select one or more sports channels, Then the system must use those selected channels in the user's news experience.

requirement_text: The system must provide a live ticker for users to follow live results of their favorite teams.
requirement_reference: "In addition to the news, users can follow the results of their favorite teams live via a live ticker."

user_story.story: As a football fan, I want to follow my favorite teams through a live ticker so that I can track match results while games are in progress.
user_story.Acceptance: Given one of my favorite teams is playing, When I open the live ticker, Then the system must display the live result information for that team.

requirement_text: The system must provide coverage of national and international leagues and competitions.
requirement_reference: "Our app will offer extensive coverage of all leagues and competitions, both national and international."

user_story.story: As a football fan, I want access to national and international competition coverage so that I can follow football broadly.
user_story.Acceptance: Given I browse leagues or competitions in the app, When I view available coverage, Then the system must present national and international leagues and competitions.

requirement_text: The system must provide detailed team information.
requirement_reference: "Detailed team and player information will also be available at any time."

user_story.story: As a football fan, I want to view detailed team information so that I can learn more about clubs I follow.
user_story.Acceptance: Given I open a team profile, When the page loads, Then the system must display detailed information for that team.

requirement_text: The system must provide detailed player information.
requirement_reference: "Detailed team and player information will also be available at any time."

user_story.story: As a football fan, I want to view detailed player information so that I can learn more about players of interest.
user_story.Acceptance: Given I open a player profile, When the page loads, Then the system must display detailed information for that player.

requirement_text: The system must integrate live stream links from supported broadcast providers such as DAZN or Sky Sport.
requirement_reference: "Another highlight is the integration of live stream links, for example, from providers such as DAZN or Sky Sport."

user_story.story: As a football fan, I want access to supported live stream links in the app so that I can navigate quickly to live broadcasts.
user_story.Acceptance: Given a supported provider offers a relevant live broadcast, When I view the related match in the app, Then the system must display the available live stream link from that provider.

requirement_text: The system must display live stream links only after the corresponding live broadcast has begun.
requirement_reference: "These are available directly in the app as soon as the live broadcast has begun."

user_story.story: As a football fan, I want live stream links to appear only when a broadcast is live so that I am not sent to unavailable streams.
user_story.Acceptance: Given a match broadcast has not yet started, When I view the match in the app, Then no live stream link for that broadcast must be shown. Given the live broadcast has started, When I refresh or open the match view, Then the live stream link must be displayed.

requirement_text: The system must enforce country-based transmission-rights validation before displaying live stream links.
requirement_reference: "Live streams will only be displayed when the respective rights are fulfilled in the country."

user_story.story: As a user, I want only legally available live streams shown in my country so that I access compliant viewing options.
user_story.Acceptance: Given a live stream exists for a match, When I access the match from a country where rights are not fulfilled, Then the system must not display the live stream link. Given rights are fulfilled in my country, When I access the match, Then the system must display the live stream link.

requirement_text: The system must include an integrated live ticker module that retrieves and displays live match data in real time.
requirement_reference: "To implement this function, the app includes an integrated live ticker module that enables the retrieval and display of live data in real time."

user_story.story: As a football fan, I want the live ticker module to retrieve and display live match data in real time so that I can follow matches as events happen.
user_story.Acceptance: Given a live match is in progress, When I open the live ticker module, Then the system must retrieve current live data and display it in the ticker.

requirement_text: The live ticker module must communicate with the user interface to continuously update current match data.
requirement_reference: "The live ticker module communicates directly via the interface with the user interface to display and continuously update current match data."

user_story.story: As a football fan, I want the live ticker screen to update continuously so that I always see the latest match information.
user_story.Acceptance: Given I am viewing a live ticker for an active match, When new match data is received, Then the user interface must update the displayed match data without requiring me to reopen the screen.

requirement_text: The system must retrieve live data via an API from an external server.
requirement_reference: "The live data is retrieved via an API from an external server."

user_story.story: As a user, I want live data to be sourced dynamically from an external service so that match updates can be provided accurately.
user_story.Acceptance: Given live match data is required, When the live ticker module requests updates, Then the system must retrieve the live data through an API connection to an external server.

requirement_text: The system must provide additional modules that allow users to individually configure the app.
requirement_reference: "In addition to the live ticker module, the app also offers additional modules that allow users to individually configure the app"

user_story.story: As a user, I want configurable app modules so that I can personalize the application to my preferences.
user_story.Acceptance: Given I open the configuration area, When I modify available module settings, Then the system must save and apply my individualized configuration.

requirement_text: The system must provide a user interface through which users can directly access app information and manage displayed modules.
requirement_reference: "The user interface is designed so that users can access the information in the app directly. The user interface is a key component of the app and connects various modules that are displayed together and managed via the interface."

user_story.story: As a user, I want a central interface to access information and manage app modules so that navigation is straightforward.
user_story.Acceptance: Given I am using the app, When I navigate through the interface, Then I must be able to access available information and manage the displayed modules through the user interface.

requirement_text: The system must integrate with a notification system that sends users information about current events when notifications are activated.
requirement_reference: "Furthermore, the app is linked to a notification system that provides users with information about current events as soon as the notification function is activated."

user_story.story: As a user, I want to receive notifications about current events when I enable notifications so that I stay informed promptly.
user_story.Acceptance: Given notifications are activated for my account, When a current event occurs, Then the system must send a notification to me.

requirement_text: The system must allow users to register directly at app startup.
requirement_reference: "Registration and login are designed to be uncomplicated and can be completed directly at app startup."

user_story.story: As a new user, I want to register at app startup so that I can begin using personalized features immediately.
user_story.Acceptance: Given I launch the app as a new user, When I choose to register during startup, Then the system must allow me to complete registration from the startup flow.

requirement_text: The system must allow users to log in directly at app startup.
requirement_reference: "Registration and login are designed to be uncomplicated and can be completed directly at app startup."

user_story.story: As a returning user, I want to log in at app startup so that I can access my account quickly.
user_story.Acceptance: Given I launch the app as a returning user, When I choose to log in during startup, Then the system must allow me to complete login from the startup flow.

requirement_text: The system must allow users to follow favorite clubs.
requirement_reference: "Users have the option to personalize their experience by following favorite clubs"

user_story.story: As a football fan, I want to follow my favorite clubs so that the app can tailor content to my interests.
user_story.Acceptance: Given I am viewing a club or personalization screen, When I mark a club as a favorite, Then the system must save that club to my followed favorites list.

requirement_text: The system must allow users to receive notifications about news or results of their favorite teams.
requirement_reference: "and receiving notifications about news or results of their favorite teams."

user_story.story: As a football fan, I want notifications about news and results of my favorite teams so that I can stay updated without opening the app constantly.
user_story.Acceptance: Given I follow a team and have enabled notifications, When there is relevant news or a result update for that team, Then the system must send me a notification about that event.

requirement_text: The system must allow users to share news and game reports via social media directly from the app.
requirement_reference: "In addition, users can share news and game reports via social media directly from the app."

user_story.story: As a user, I want to share news and game reports directly to social media so that I can easily share football content with others.
user_story.Acceptance: Given I am viewing a news item or game report, When I select the share action and choose a social media destination, Then the system must initiate sharing of that content from within the app.
